newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed as markets awaits NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed as markets awaits NYMEX.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline was firm. Eurograde barges traded at $202.25 and $202.50 fob AR, about eight potential arb cargoes were on offer.
Gas oil prices hovered around unchanged to slightly up with barge and cargo premiums stable but outright prices vulnerable to choppy trade on benchmark gas oil futures.

High sulphur barges ignored crude's strength to lose $1 and trade at $84/$85 a tonne. Poor bunker demand and negative sentiment drove it down. Low sulphur straight-run was eagerly sought with the last deal heard at $103 fob.
